description: Search commercial real estate listings. Returns paginated hits with facet counts; every hit carries the public `url` to cite and its `listed_at` / `updated_at` stamps. For AI-driven search, call interpret_search first to convert a natural-language query into structured filters, then pass those filters — and its bounds, when present — here.

bounds.description: Geographic bounding box (degrees) limiting hits to an area. Forward the bounds returned by interpret_search verbatim to honour "near <place>" intent; omit for a nationwide search.

filters.description: Structured filter map keyed by Typesense field name. Ranges as {min?, max?}, multi-select as string[], booleans as true/false. Call get_registry to see valid field names and allowed values.

query.description: Free-text search query (street address, city, or keyword). Omit or pass null for no text filter.

sort.description: Sort key. Valid values from get_registry sort_options (e.g. "listed_at:desc", "price:asc").

name: search_listings
title: Search listings
